def growth_counts(n):
    fixed = 1
    linear = 0
    pairs = 0
    for i in range(n):
        linear += 1
        for j in range(n):
            pairs += 1
    halvings = 0
    remaining = n
    while remaining > 1:
        remaining //= 2
        halvings += 1
    return fixed, linear, pairs, halvings
